description: Two-panel transmission electron microscopy composite of 2Ni low-density austenitic steel imaged close to final failure; both panels are annotated "LD" immediately after the panel letter. (a) is a dark-field TEM micrograph with a 30 nm scale bar: bright, mottled κ-carbide particles populate a dark matrix in a wavy, banded/modulated arrangement, with a narrow darker vertical line running through the centre-right of the field. (b) is a high-resolution TEM (HRTEM) image with a 10 nm scale bar showing the same material at lattice resolution: fine parallel lattice fringes appear in brighter patches against mottled darker regions, crossed in the middle by a vertical packet of near-parallel fringes. No interplanar spacing (d-value), zone axis or crystallographic indices are printed on either panel. Together the two panels document the size scale, spatial distribution and internal lattice structure of the κ-carbides in the near-fracture deformation state, complementing the slip-band, stacking-fault and dislocation substructure evidence reported for the same steel; the caption explicitly assigns (a) to dark-field κ-carbide imaging and (b) to κ-carbide HRTEM.

subfigures.description: Dark-field TEM micrograph with a 30 nm scale bar, annotated '(a)LD'. Bright, mottled κ-carbide particles of nanometre scale are distributed through a dark matrix in a wavy, banded/modulated pattern; a narrow darker vertical line crosses the centre-right of the field. No index or d-spacing labels.

HRTEM image with a 10 nm scale bar, annotated '(b)LD'. Fine parallel lattice fringes are visible in brighter contrast patches against mottled darker areas, with a vertical near-parallel fringe packet through the middle. No interplanar spacing, zone axis or index annotations are printed.

observations.observation: Panel (a) is a dark-field TEM micrograph bearing a 30 nm scale bar and showing bright κ-carbide particles dispersed in a dark matrix.
The bright κ-carbide features in (a) are arranged in wavy, banded/modulated rows rather than randomly, with particle separations on the order of the 30 nm scale bar.
A narrow darker vertical line runs through the centre-right of the field in (a), interpreted visually as a linear defect or bend/crack-like feature.

Panel (b) is a high-resolution TEM image with a 10 nm scale bar in which fine parallel lattice fringes are resolved in brighter patches, including a vertical fringe packet through the middle of the frame.
Both panels carry the annotation 'LD' printed directly after the panel letter; its meaning is not defined in the caption or in the visible figure text.
Neither panel prints an interplanar spacing (d-value), zone axis, or crystallographic index, so the lattice plane identified in (b) cannot be assigned from the figure alone.
The caption states that (a) is a dark field image of κ-carbides and (b) is an HRTEM image of κ-carbides.
The caption states the images are of 2Ni steel close to final failure.

The citing text places this figure at the near-fracture state of 2Ni steel, following the reported deformation substructure evolution of planar slip bands, high-density dislocations and stacking faults (with no deformation twins detected).
The two panels are complementary but not strictly a HRTEM-of-the-same-area pair as far as the pixels show: the 10 nm field of (b) cannot be matched field-for-field to the 30 nm field of (a).
